sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
I need to create a repository first — since I can't create repositories directly, I'll create all three projects as files I'll write out for you. Let me build all three complete projects now.

Here are your **3 complete RAG projects** using the latest LangChain (`1.3.2`), `langchain-openai` (`1.2.2`), OpenAI Embeddings, and FAISS:

sections.title: Quick Start
sections.body:
**1. Set up environment variables:**
```bash
cp project-1-basic-rag/.env.example project-1-basic-rag/.env
# Add your OpenAI API key
```

**2. Install dependencies (per project):**
```bash
cd project-1-basic-rag && pip install -r requirements.txt
cd project-2-advanced-search && pip install -r requirements.txt
cd project-3-metadata-filtering && pip install -r requirements.txt
```

**3. Run each project:**
```bash
python project-1-basic-rag/main.py
python project-2-advanced-search/main.py
python project-3-metadata-filtering/main.py
```

sections.title: Key API Notes (LangChain 1.3.2)
sections.body:
| API | Notes |
|---|---|
| `FAISS.from_documents()` | Creates store from scratch |
| `FAISS.load_local(..., allow_dangerous_deserialization=True)` | Required flag for loading |
| `FAISS.save_local(path)` | Saves `index.faiss` + `index.pkl` |
| `vector_store.add_documents(docs, ids=[...])` | Adds to existing store |
| `vector_store.delete([id1, id2])` | Delete by docstore key |
| `vector_store.docstore._dict` | Access all stored docs |
| `vector_store.similarity_search_with_relevance_scores()` | Returns 0–1 normalized scores |
| `vector_store.max_marginal_relevance_search()` | MMR for diverse results |
| `vector_store.as_retriever(search_type="mmr")` | Retriever interface |
